title: Parent and baby unit not paired
shortDescription: Units out of range or not linked.
fullDescription:
Philips Avent SCD series shows No Connection when parent unit loses DECT link with baby unit — usually distance or interference.

Move closer, re-pair units, restart both.

Safety note: always verify connection before leaving baby unattended.

fixSteps.title: Move closer
fixSteps.instruction: Reduce distance between units to under 50 ft.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Follow manual to re-pair units if needed.

whenToCallPro: For baby monitors, contact Philips support if re-pairing fails
videoSearchQuery: philips avent baby monitor no connection pair

faq.a: Up to 330m outdoor, 50m indoor depending on walls.

title: Parent unit battery low
fullDescription:
Parent unit battery icon flashing and audible alert — unit needs charging.

Return to charging dock.

Safety note: charge nightly to avoid overnight loss of monitoring.

fixSteps.title: Charge
fixSteps.instruction: Place parent unit on charging dock.

whenToCallPro: For baby monitors, contact Philips support if battery won't hold charge
videoSearchQuery: philips avent parent unit low battery

title: Baby unit battery or power issue
shortDescription: Baby unit low battery or unplugged.
fullDescription:
Baby unit shows low battery or has been unplugged. The parent unit will alert.

Connect baby unit to mains power (recommended for overnight use).

Safety note: baby unit is best kept plugged in for continuous monitoring.
whenToCallPro: For baby monitors, contact Philips support if power adapter fails
videoSearchQuery: philips avent baby unit power issue

faq.a: Yes but not recommended for night monitoring.

title: Parent unit too far from baby unit
fullDescription:
Out Of Range alert triggers when distance exceeds the DECT connection limit.

Move parent unit closer; minimize walls between units.

Safety note: do not rely on monitoring when out of range — return promptly.

fixSteps.title: Return closer
fixSteps.instruction: Move within range; alert stops automatically.

whenToCallPro: For baby monitors, contact Philips support if range is very short
videoSearchQuery: philips avent out of range alert

faq.a: Yes — concrete/metal walls significantly reduce DECT range.

title: Room temperature out of range
fullDescription:
SCD models with temperature sensor alert when nursery temperature is outside set range (typically 16-20°C / 61-68°F).

Adjust room temperature via heating/cooling.

Safety note: AAP recommends 20°C (68°F) for infant sleep.

fixSteps.title: Adjust room
fixSteps.instruction: Use HVAC to bring room to target temp.

whenToCallPro: For baby monitors, contact Philips support if sensor readings look wrong

title: Baby unit microphone fault
shortDescription: Mic not detected on baby unit.
fullDescription:
Microphone error indicates hardware fault with baby unit mic — monitor cannot transmit audio.

Power cycle; if persistent, contact Philips for warranty.

Safety note: CRITICAL — do not use without audio; get replacement promptly.
whenToCallPro: Contact Philips support — do not rely on monitor without working microphone
videoSearchQuery: philips avent microphone error baby unit

title: Radio interference detected
fullDescription:
Interference from Wi-Fi routers, cordless phones, or other baby monitors can cause static or dropouts.

Move monitor away from routers; try different channel if model supports it.

Safety note: heavy interference reduces reliability.

fixSteps.title: Separate devices
fixSteps.instruction: Move baby unit at least 3m from routers/phones.

whenToCallPro: For baby monitors, contact Philips support if interference is severe

faq.q: DECT more secure than Wi-Fi monitors?
faq.a: Yes — DECT is encrypted and less hackable.

title: Video monitor lost camera feed
fullDescription:
Video models (SCD843, SCD921) show Camera Offline when video link drops — distance, power, or pairing issue.

Check camera power; re-pair if needed.

Safety note: verify audio and video before relying.
whenToCallPro: For baby monitors, contact Philips support if camera won't pair

faq.a: Yes — infrared activates automatically in low light.

title: Parent unit volume muted
fullDescription:
Volume set to zero on parent unit — you won't hear baby. LED sound indicators still work.

Increase volume via side buttons.

Safety note: always verify audio works before sleep.
whenToCallPro: For baby monitors, contact Philips support if volume buttons don't respond

title: Parent unit not charging
shortDescription: Charging dock not charging parent unit.
fullDescription:
Charge Error indicates parent unit is not charging despite being on dock — contact issue or failed battery.

Clean dock contacts; try different outlet; replace battery if possible.

Safety note: use only Philips-approved chargers.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe dock and unit contacts with dry cloth.

whenToCallPro: For baby monitors, contact Philips support for replacement battery
videoSearchQuery: philips avent parent unit charge error
